description: Loaded Containers Monthly Imports and Exports Through Port Authority of NY NJ Maritime Terminals: Beginning 2000 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset describes the total volume of Import and Export Loaded Containers moved through maritime terminals located within Port Authority property in the Port of New York and New Jersey in Twenty Foot Equivalent Units (TEUs). It is reflected and reported on an annual basis. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are maritime, port authority, teus, containers, port. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Port Authority of NY & NJ. The portal shows 2016-03-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
